question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a gold ball, Bob has a brown ball, Claire has a red ball, Dave has a grey ball, Eve has a black ball, Fred has a pink ball, and Gertrude has a silver ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Eve and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Then, Bob and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Finally, Fred and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) gold ball
(B) brown ball
(C) red ball
(D) grey ball
(E) black ball
(F) pink ball
(G) silver ball
solution:
Ball colors in player order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (gold, brown, red, grey, black, pink, silver)
1. Eve ↔ Gertrude: (gold, brown, red, grey, silver, pink, black)
2. Gertrude ↔ Dave: (gold, brown, red, black, silver, pink, grey)
3. Gertrude ↔ Dave: (gold, brown, red, grey, silver, pink, black)
4. Bob ↔ Gertrude: (gold, black, red, grey, silver, pink, brown)
5. Gertrude ↔ Claire: (gold, black, brown, grey, silver, pink, red)
6. Fred ↔ Dave: (gold, black, brown, pink, silver, grey, red)
7. Fred ↔ Alice: (grey, black, brown, pink, silver, gold, red)
Claire has the brown ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
